name: Fresh Senior Dog Turkey with Vegetables

variants.name: Turkey with Vegetables 400 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Fresh Senior is a complete and balanced food for senior dogs. The fresh turkey meat content guarantees the high biological value of the recipe. Vegetables are an ideal source of carbohydrates, which provide daily energy, as well as dietary fibre, which supports healthy bowel function.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Meat and derivatives (fresh meat; turkey 26% and pork liver 5%), vegetables (carrots, peas and potatoes 6%), cereals, oils and fats, mineral substances, powdered milk protein.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 7.0%, Crude fibre: 0.5%, Crude fats: 6.0%, Crude ash: 3.0%, Moisture: 79%

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 450 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopherol-acetate) 15 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.04 mg/kg) 0.018 mg/kg, Manganese (Manganous sulphate monohydrate 9 mg/kg) 2.9 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 32 mg/kg): 25.7 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3.5 mg/kg) 0.89 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate15 mg/kg) 4.93 mg/ kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 1.8 mg/kg) 1.17 mg/kg.
